options.name: Soft Split
options.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: new bold minimal geometric icon for kollens.
Input images: Images 1, 2, 3 and 4 are STYLE AND CONSTRUCTION REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets. Take inspiration from broad filled optical planes, separated K geometry and controlled rounding; create a new silhouette, never trace any supplied mark. Do not reproduce reference text, watermarks or TM.
Direction 35: SOFT SPLIT. A bold three-piece K consisting of a clipped or tapered upright spine and two big upper/lower right wings. Few solid planes, balanced compact and softly rectangular structure. Generous controlled outer corner fillets, but clear sharp diagonal cut edges. Separate the pieces with consistent generous six-unit negative gaps on a 128-unit grid; no point contacts. Keep the main vertical stem substantial and the wings broad, with a precise horizontal middle gap. Exact matched upper/lower wing proportions, mathematically stable and visually balanced original silhouette.
Composition: one centered icon, about 60% of a square canvas width, plain flat charcoal #101113 background, generous margins. Icon only: no text, no wordmark, no extra elements.
Medium/color: absolutely clean crisp vector-like filled shape logo, one perfectly uniform solid gold #F9C932.
Avoid: tiny details, frames, dots, fine lines, gradients, grain, texture, glow, lighting, shadows, 3D, mockups, labels, watermarks, TM, replicas of the supplied marks.

options.name: Round Facet
options.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: new bold minimal geometric icon for kollens.
Input images: Images 1, 2, 3 and 4 are STYLE AND CONSTRUCTION REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets. Use the circular optical construction of image 1 and chunky few-facet logic of image 4 as inspiration for an original new silhouette. Do not trace or reproduce any supplied mark, watermark, text or TM.
Direction 36: ROUND FACET. Three or four substantial filled circular-quarter / prismatic facets arranged as a geometric K. A bold rounded inside shoulder and a single repeated cut-plane rhythm. Very clearly rounder than a standard three-polygon K: large circular outer shoulders, generous smooth counter curves and heavy shared masses create a lens-friendly optical silhouette. Each component has a simple precisely defined circular arc combined with a clean straight cut. Solid compact masses, one consistent angular cut rhythm, controlled tangent joins, deliberate broad negative space, equal gaps of at least six units on a 128-unit grid, no touching tips. Distinct optical curved K rather than a conventional block-letter glyph. No frame, no dots, no tiny details.
Composition: one centered single icon at around 60% of square canvas width on a plain flat charcoal #101113 background. Generous margins. Icon only: no wordmark or text, no extra elements.
Medium/color: perfectly flat gold #F9C932 only, absolutely crisp clean vector-like edges and uniform fills.
Avoid: generic camera, eye outline, concentric bullseye, thin outlines, tiny cuts, gradients, grain, texture, glow, lighting, shadows, 3D, mockups, labels, watermarks, TM, any exact replica of the references.
